Four existing shared concrete/paint/canvas/window-grid graphs; no bespoke texture atlas/copied seating bitmap/logos/hidden furnished rooms. Far levels merge repeated detail, retain mast/head identity and use solid ramp masses/expanded simplified seating aperture.
